status: Qualified representative timestamp-order extension for insert-only ordinary ROW_NUMBER on released Flink 2.2.1. Existing TTL/updating/order-shape/type gates remain.
method: Interleaved engines, identical queries/data/resources, two warmups/five measured trials; runtime row source, rowwise sink and production transposes/JNI/state retained. Current native rank and both transposes plus consumed-input metrics asserted. Previous control verifies rank stays on Flink while retaining any other substitutions it supports. No concurrent local build/test/profile/timing; all warmups/ranges retained. Timestamp order derives from runtime integer milliseconds in whole jobs; exact nanoseconds and pre-epoch values have separate SQL/native coverage.

validation.recovery: Two memory/RocksDB restores; exact runtime TIMESTAMP9/LTZ9, null placements, physical splits, ties and retained floating payload fields. Flink1.18 itself rejects non-time OVER.

limits: Two timestamp types, ascending/descending arrivals, 131072 input rows and1024keys. All SQLorders are ASC, not descending ORDER BY. Does not establish universal speedup, bounded state size or support for updating input/TTL/floating sort.
